lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，脚离土半尺
lines.en: I fly just above the ground, a hand-span up.

lines.zh: 个子不高，步子却很快
lines.en: Not tall, but my steps are quick.

lines.zh: 我侧身走，把正面留给你
lines.en: I move sideways, keeping my front toward you.

lines.zh: 一边走一边用手比划招式
lines.en: I walk while tracing a move with my hands.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走半圈，找角度
lines.en: I walk half around you, hunting an angle.

lines.zh: 脚下带起一小股气旋
lines.en: A small ki swirl follows my feet.

lines.zh: 我走得随性，但落地很稳
lines.en: My walk looks casual, but my footing is sure.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢正面对冲，走着找机会
lines.en: I dislike head-on clashes; I walk to find openings.

lines.zh: 步幅小，频率快，很难抓住
lines.en: Short strides, high tempo, hard to catch.

lines.zh: 我退着走，眼睛一直朝你
lines.en: I walk backward, eyes fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，试探你的反应
lines.en: One step forward, testing your reaction.

lines.zh: 十六格高的身形，走起来轻得像没重量
lines.en: One and a half blocks of me moving almost weightless.

lines.zh: 我摊开手，一副无所谓的样子
lines.en: I spread my hands, looking unbothered.

lines.zh: 气在掌心里绕了两圈
lines.en: Ki coils twice in my palm.

lines.zh: 我在想该用哪一招，省钱的那种
lines.en: I am deciding which move to use, the cheap one.

lines.zh: 个子矮，站得却最挺
lines.en: Short, but I stand the straightest.

lines.zh: 我捏了捏拳头，骨节咔响
lines.en: I squeeze my fist; the knuckles pop.

lines.zh: 头顶的太阳太亮，我眯起眼
lines.en: The sun is too bright; I squint.

lines.zh: 我不像别人那么绷着，但也没松
lines.en: I am not as tense as the others, but not loose either.

lines.zh: 脚边的石子被我气推开了
lines.en: Pebbles at my feet are pushed away by my ki.

lines.zh: 我数着周围有几个人
lines.en: I count how many people are around.

lines.zh: 这招我练了无数遍，闭眼都会
lines.en: I have drilled this move countless times.

lines.zh: 我在等你先动，我不喜欢先出手
lines.en: I wait for you to move; I dislike striking first.

lines.zh: 后背有点凉，风从那边来
lines.en: My back feels cold; the wind comes from there.

lines.zh: 手掌竖起来，比了个架势
lines.en: I raise my palm edge-on into a stance.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，其实没在笑
lines.en: I smile a little; it is not really a smile.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，比我高不少
lines.en: I look up at you; you are quite a bit taller.

lines.zh: 你的气我读完了，不算离谱
lines.en: I have read your ki; it is not absurd.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，护住自己的中线
lines.en: I turn my shoulder to guard my centerline.

lines.zh: 手指在身侧轻轻弹了一下
lines.en: My fingers flick once at my side.

lines.zh: 你手上没有武器，这很好
lines.en: No weapon in your hands; good.

lines.zh: 我看你的膝盖，不看你举起来的手
lines.en: I watch your knees, not your raised hands.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，两米还是三米
lines.en: I am measuring distance: two meters or three?

lines.zh: 你先说话吧，我听着
lines.en: You speak first; I am listening.

lines.zh: 我不摆架子，也不让位
lines.en: I put on no airs, and I give no ground.

lines.zh: 这一带的人都认得我这张脸
lines.en: Everyone around here knows this face.

lines.zh: 你比我高，那我就贴得更近
lines.en: You are taller, so I will get even closer.

lines.zh: 我把气收得极紧，你看不出来
lines.en: My ki is coiled tight; you cannot tell.

lines.zh: 我抬手示意，只是示意
lines.en: I raise a hand, only a gesture.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势不像练过的
lines.en: Your walk does not look trained.

lines.zh: 我不是最难打的，但我最不容易被抓住
lines.en: I am not the hardest hitter, but the hardest to catch.

lines.zh: 我眨了下眼，你就动了
lines.en: I blink once, and you move.

lines.zh: 别看我矮，我站到过更凶的对手面前
lines.en: Short as I am, I have faced far worse.

lines.zh: 我被打得退了两步，稳住了
lines.en: Two steps back, and I hold.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙笑了一下
lines.en: I grit my teeth and half-smile.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，别再来第二下
lines.en: That one was heavy; do not try it twice.

lines.zh: 血从鼻下流下来，我懒得擦
lines.en: Blood runs under my nose; I do not bother.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手腕，重新握拳
lines.en: I shake my wrist and re-clench my fist.

lines.zh: 小个子的好处，是伤口也小
lines.en: The benefit of being small: small wounds too.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，架势没散
lines.en: It hurts, but my stance holds.

lines.zh: 我退到半空，缓了口气
lines.en: I drift up to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 你的力气我记住了
lines.en: I have memorized your strength.

lines.zh: 我闻到饭味，肚子先叫了
lines.en: I smell a meal, and my stomach answers first.

lines.zh: 吃的？我从不拒绝
lines.en: Food? I never refuse.

lines.zh: 我伸手前先看了看四周
lines.en: I check around before reaching out.

lines.zh: 这一顿我记你人情
lines.en: I will owe you for this meal.

lines.zh: 我接过来就吃，不客气
lines.en: I take it and eat, no ceremony.

lines.zh: 在场上吃这个不太合适
lines.en: Eating this mid-fight is awkward.

lines.zh: 我嚼两口，力气回来了
lines.en: Two chews and my strength returns.

lines.zh: 我只是嘴馋，不是补给
lines.en: I am just hungry, not resupplying.

lines.zh: 吃完了再打，别急
lines.en: Let me finish, then we fight.

lines.zh: 我舔了下手指，很满足
lines.en: I lick my fingers, satisfied.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，立刻借力弹开
lines.en: I hit you and spring off the impact.

lines.zh: 个子小，反倒好卸力
lines.en: Being small makes it easy to shed force.

lines.zh: 我没被撞退，只晃了一下
lines.en: I am not knocked back, only swayed.

lines.zh: 这一撞提醒我，你力气不小
lines.en: That bump reminds me you are strong.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡在你和我中间
lines.en: I put my forearm between us.

lines.zh: 气在体表垫了一层
lines.en: A layer of ki cushions my body.

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，衣角绞在一起
lines.en: We brush past, our clothes tangling.

lines.zh: 地上的土被气推成一道弧
lines.en: Ki pushes the dirt into an arc.

lines.zh: 你撞得比我狠，但没占到便宜
lines.en: You hit harder, but gained nothing.

lines.zh: 撞完我换个位置，不留在原处
lines.en: After the impact I move off that spot.

lines.zh: 我们是同门，背靠背就够了
lines.en: We are comrades; back to back is enough.

lines.zh: 你打上三路，我扫下三路
lines.en: You take high, I sweep low.

lines.zh: 这种默契，是挨打挨出来的
lines.en: This understanding came from taking hits together.

lines.zh: 我把最危险的位置留给自己
lines.en: I keep the most dangerous spot for myself.

lines.zh: 我们同时出招，气叠在一处
lines.en: We strike together, our ki stacking.

lines.zh: 谁先倒下，另一个就补上
lines.en: Whoever falls first, the other fills in.

lines.zh: 我不太会说漂亮话，就这样吧
lines.en: I am not good with fine words; this will do.

lines.zh: 你的气稳，我的气活，正好互补
lines.en: Your ki is steady, mine is nimble; we fit.

lines.zh: 远处那伙人，我们一人一半
lines.en: That group over there: half each.

lines.zh: 打完这架，一起去吃点东西
lines.en: After this fight, let us go eat.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，随手抛了一下
lines.en: I pick it up and toss it once.

lines.zh: 用小东西分散注意力，很好用
lines.en: Small objects make fine distractions.

lines.zh: 我把豆子塞进腰带里
lines.en: I tuck the bean into my belt.

lines.zh: 这个不轻，得使点劲
lines.en: Not light; it takes some effort.

lines.zh: 我一边捡一边看你的手
lines.en: I pick it up while watching your hands.

lines.zh: 我握了握，判断质地
lines.en: I squeeze it to judge the texture.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我顺势退了一步
lines.en: I drop it, which lets me step back.

lines.zh: 我把石头捏碎，当烟幕
lines.en: I crush the stone into a screen of dust.

lines.zh: 这个我用得上，谢了
lines.en: This one is useful; thanks.

lines.zh: 我收好，回头再算
lines.en: I put it away, to settle later.

lines.zh: 你气一动，我就找到了角度
lines.en: The moment your ki stirs, I find my angle.

lines.zh: 我不冲正面，我从斜后方进
lines.en: I do not charge head-on; I come from the rear flank.

lines.zh: 身高的差距，正好让我钻进来
lines.en: The height gap lets me slip inside.

lines.zh: 我在算你的出手距离
lines.en: I am calculating your reach.

lines.zh: 这一招，我瞄准的是你的重心
lines.en: I am aiming at your balance, not your body.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼就决定了
lines.en: One look and it is decided.

lines.zh: 你的站姿偏左，我就往右切
lines.en: Your stance leans left, so I cut right.

lines.zh: 我压低身形，从下方切入
lines.en: I sink low and cut in from beneath.

lines.zh: 气圆斩的样子，你该认得
lines.en: You should recognize the shape of the Destructo Disc.

lines.zh: 我不用全力，先试一手
lines.en: Not full power; just a test.

lines.zh: 这不是挑衅，是判断
lines.en: This is not a taunt; it is judgment.

lines.zh: 你还在找我，我已经到了
lines.en: You are still searching; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 我不喊招式名，浪费气
lines.en: I do not shout move names; it wastes ki.

lines.zh: 我把你的闪避方向先占了
lines.en: I take your likely dodge line first.

lines.zh: 近距离，这招最省
lines.en: At close range, this is cheapest.

lines.zh: 决定了，就这么打
lines.en: Decided, this is how it goes.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的侧面，一直不正面
lines.en: I hug your flank, never your front.

lines.zh: 你的手抬起来，我就换位
lines.en: When your hand lifts, I change position.

lines.zh: 我在等你用力过猛的那一下
lines.en: I wait for the swing that goes too far.

lines.zh: 个子矮的好处，是难被正面碰到
lines.en: The gift of being short is being hard to hit squarely.

lines.zh: 我退半步，不是怕，是量距离
lines.en: I step back, not from fear, but to measure.

lines.zh: 气在指间聚成一个盘
lines.en: Ki gathers into a disc between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，脚步声很轻
lines.en: I orbit you, my steps soft.

lines.zh: 你追我，就失位了
lines.en: Chase me, and you lose position.

lines.zh: 我的气藏得住，你读不出我要出哪招
lines.en: My ki stays hidden; you cannot read my move.

lines.zh: 这一手是留着打远的
lines.en: This one is saved for fighting at range.

lines.zh: 你一停，我就靠上去
lines.en: When you stop, I close in.

lines.zh: 太阳光的角度对我有利
lines.en: The angle of the sun favors me.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了下眼睛，是假的
lines.en: I raise a hand to shade my eyes; it is a feint.

lines.zh: 我已经站在你出手的死角
lines.en: I am already in your blind arc.

lines.zh: 等你出手，我就闪，然后打
lines.en: You strike, I slip, then I hit.

lines.zh: 这不叫缠，这叫磨
lines.en: This is not clinging, it is grinding you down.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变重了，我听见了
lines.en: Your breathing has grown heavy; I hear it.

lines.zh: 一记短拳，打在腰侧
lines.en: A short punch into your flank.

lines.zh: 我从下方切入，肘往上顶
lines.en: I cut in low and drive my elbow up.

lines.zh: 我踢你的脚踝，让你失稳
lines.en: I kick your ankle to spoil your footing.

lines.zh: 气聚在掌缘，像刀
lines.en: Ki gathers on my palm edge like a blade.

lines.zh: 这一下是气圆斩，别硬接
lines.en: This is the Destructo Disc; do not block it.

lines.zh: 双手推出，气浪扑面
lines.en: Both palms thrust, a wave of ki in your face.

lines.zh: 你被推退两步，我跟上
lines.en: You slide back two paces; I follow.

lines.zh: 我打完就退，从不恋战
lines.en: I strike and retreat, never lingering.

lines.zh: 龟派气功的起手，你看清了
lines.en: You saw the Kamehameha stance begin.

lines.zh: 我故意慢半拍，让你以为能挡
lines.en: I slow half a beat so you think you can block.

lines.zh: 这一拳只是开路
lines.en: That punch was only to open the way.

lines.zh: 我绕到背后补一下，很轻
lines.en: I slip behind for a light tap.

lines.zh: 你出手的瞬间，我已经让开了
lines.en: The instant you strike, I am already gone.

lines.zh: 我不靠力，靠准
lines.en: I do not rely on force, but on precision.

lines.zh: 这一招练了太久，出手就成了
lines.en: A move drilled so long it simply happens.

lines.zh: 打完我喘了口气，没让你看见
lines.en: I catch a breath after, out of your sight.

lines.zh: 一道矮影子落在场上，是我
lines.en: A short shadow lands on the field: me.

lines.zh: 我从结构门口走出来，拍了拍衣服
lines.en: I walk out of the structure door and dust myself off.

lines.zh: 这里有人叫我来，说是有麻烦
lines.en: Someone called me here, said there was trouble.

lines.zh: 我来了，谁先说打
lines.en: I am here; who wants to start.

lines.zh: 气流散开，我落在离你一臂远
lines.en: The ki clears and I land an arm's length away.

lines.zh: 我不是自然生成的，别找了
lines.en: I am not a natural spawn; stop looking.

lines.zh: 战斗力的差距我看得清，不算大
lines.en: I can see the power gap; it is not large.

lines.zh: 我一落地就找好退路
lines.en: The moment I land, I pick my exit.

lines.zh: 这地方的风向对我不好
lines.en: The wind here is against me.

lines.zh: 我的手已经抬到胸前了
lines.en: My hands are already at my chest.

lines.zh: 个子不高，气势不低
lines.en: Not tall, but my presence is not small.

lines.zh: 我先看了一圈人，才看你
lines.en: I scan everyone here before I look at you.

lines.zh: 地板上的灰被气吹成圈
lines.en: Dust on the floor is blown into a ring.

lines.zh: 这颗星的重力，我早习惯了
lines.en: I am used to the gravity of this world by now.

lines.zh: 太阳拳的起手，就是这一抬手
lines.en: The Solar Flare begins with exactly this raised hand.

lines.zh: 有人在远处数我们的气
lines.en: Someone far off is counting our ki.

lines.zh: 我摆好架势，等你过来
lines.en: I set my stance and wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 不是最强的，但我站到了这里
lines.en: Not the strongest, but I am standing here.

lines.zh: 火扑到脸上，我一边退一边拍
lines.en: Fire hits my face; I slap it out while retreating.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，滚了半圈
lines.en: I fall from height and roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我手脚一起挣
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I kick and claw.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀飞，我翻身稳住
lines.en: The blast flings me; I flip and catch myself.

lines.zh: 有东西打中我的腿，我单膝一沉
lines.en: Something hits my leg; I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 一股外力压住我的气，动不了
lines.en: An outside force pins my ki; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 没吃饭打不动，拳都软了
lines.en: Fighting unfed, my punches go soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在肩上，整条手臂一麻
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shoulder; my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，只剩往下掉
lines.en: No ground left, only falling.
